about: I'm an undergraduate at [Middle East Technical University](https://www.metu.edu.tr/en), studying mathematics. I currently contribute to the [Galaxy Rocket Team](https://www.galaxyroket.com/), and this past summer completed a research internship at the [Türkiye National Observatory](https://trgozlemevleri.gov.tr/) under [Prof. Dr. Cahit Yeşilyaprak](https://avesis.atauni.edu.tr/cahity), working on adaptive optics and space situational awareness.
